reviewed_version: Publisher version of record, 41 pages, FoCM 26 (2026) 2165–2205, online 13 August 2025
page_convention: Physical PDF page p corresponds to printed page 2164+p

items.scope: Introduction, definitions and self-concordance calculus; physical pp. 1–10
items.checks: Read motivation, all assumptions, the dual local norms, scaling, Lemmas 1–2 and Theorems 1–3. Rechecked the DNM Hessian integration argument and decrement bound (22). Found the missing local hypothesis in Theorem 1 and an extra M_f in the last expression of (11). Distinguished M_f=0, zero residual and omega-star domain endpoints.

items.scope: PFS and adaptive PFS; physical pp. 10–17
items.checks: Traced exact path, centering invariance, decrease bound (41), reciprocal-sum argument, Theorems 5–6 and diameter logarithm. Correcting summation endpoints preserves (37); (43) as indexed fails already at N=0. The constant for printed beta/gamma is 17.14198, not <=17.1. Adaptive trial count must include each accepted trial. Figure 1 inspected. Its expression is a sum of logarithms; a product interpretation from extraction was rejected.

items.scope: Barrier feasibility and LP embedding; physical pp. 18–22
items.checks: Traced duality, depth estimate, Lemma 3, exact dual path and claimed complexity. Constructed interval barrier F=-log(1-x^2), A=1, b=1-epsilon. The retained diameter logarithm grows with epsilon, and the PFS step bound proves Omega(log(1/epsilon)) iterations to Q for fixed nu=2. Own 100-digit runs gave 34,72,148,300,603 iterations at epsilon=1e-2,1e-4,1e-8,1e-16,1e-32. LP embedding forces x^T s=0 and hence simplex boundary; positive depth hypothesis fails. Tau=0 rays cannot be dehomogenized. Literal depth maximization over delta>=0 is unbounded and needs delta<=1.

items.scope: Predictor-corrector construction and global analysis; physical pp. 23–28
items.checks: Read Lemma 4 differential inequality and Theorems 8–10. Negative tau extension is false as written: a global quartic gives an exact squared inequality violation. Predictor in (75) is not clipped consistently with t_plus: rational quartic example violates unconditional Theorem 8. The example already lies in Q, so it does not refute first-entry complexity. Corrected plus sign in rho gives positive margin 0.0247046; kappa=0.0350648 and complexity constant 13.43494 remain valid.

items.scope: Primal and dual constrained PCPFS; physical pp. 28–35
items.checks: Traced Lemmas 5–9 and Theorems 11–12, barrier gradient bounds, objective certificates, constrained Newton projection and feasible primal recovery. Theorem 12 norm identity (109) is correct under full row rank. Lemma 7 uses the wrong sign of the auxiliary path parameter; replacing t(u)-tau by t(u)+tau repairs the comparison. Verified the actual beta=.06,gamma=.254 centering bound. Noted rank, zero-direction and positive sigma qualifications and per-outer-iteration versus two-Hessian cost.

items.scope: Strong convexity, cubic regularization and restart; physical pp. 36–39
items.checks: Verified M_f=H_f/(2 sigma_f^(3/2)), Q_f scaling, conditional rate (114), halving schedule, geometric sum, and exponents 1/4,1/6,1/7. Constructed an even strongly convex log-cosh function with globally Lipschitz Hessian whose cubic step with M=1 has an exact two-cycle; M>0 alone is insufficient for the imported convergence claim. Theorem 13 conditional on (114) is not refuted. Record initial-in-Q and computable stopping qualifications for the restart.

items.scope: References, version and optional materials; physical pp. 39–41
items.checks: All 45 reference entries read and source identity/title/DOI/dates inspected. External proofs and priority comparison were not comprehensively re-fetched. No author implementation was acquired or run, and no absence-of-code defect is alleged.

limitations: The exact acquired publisher PDF was reviewed; no alternate version or subsequent correction was compared.

External cited results and literature priority claims were not all independently fetched or verified. The comparison with cited accelerated methods remains conditional on their stated rate (114) and appropriate algorithm parameters.
